Writing his philosophy specifically from ''[[Antifragile (book)|Antifragile]].''

He considered the issue of the USSR to have been that the planners had no investment in their outcomes rather than it being planned. Was not a capitalist zealot but wanted an ecomomic system with skin in the game<ref name=":0">Book VII last section</ref>

He considered Steve Jobs one of the few good CEOs<ref name=":0" />
